answer: Oak axles and iron tyres fill the wainwright yard, the wagon bed half-framed. Proof of wainwright via wagon tally — a wagon the wainwright frames only after 281 wagons run true without one wheel binding at the hub, each framed by the wainwright himself. ferrous fits the axle to the bed and bolts the ironwork fast. atlas sets the wheels on the axle and checks the track with the gauge. plume hitches the team and drives the wagon down the rutted lane. Two hundred and eighty-one wagons must run true without one wheel binding at the hub, and the next still binds where the iron ran tight.
